description: Find historic UK planning applications near a location. Give a point (WGS84), a UK postcode, or a UPRN plus a radius (default 1 mile, max 5 km); returns applications whose site falls within that radius, nearest first, or most recent first with sort 'valid_date_desc' or 'decision_date_desc' (for 'the latest application at …'), filterable by date, application type, decision (the council's words, or an outcome: ['Refused'] finds every refusal however it is worded), outcome, status, appeal and LPA, and by the scheme facts: development category, kind of work (work_kind, e.g. new_building), major development and net new homes (min/max; read by a model from the description; null until read). Each result carries its normalised outcome, distance, the council's own reference, site address, the development category, homes, unit mix, floorspace and change of use, decision and geocoding provenance; the coverage block discloses the per-LPA geocoded denominator for this growing national index; `totals` says how many applications the radius holds and how many match, and `returned` how many of them this answer lists.

NearbyFilters.description:
All optional, AND-combined (spec §3.1). An unknown key is a 400 naming it, never
ignored: a misnamed filter would otherwise answer with the filter unapplied.

application_type.description: the shared list of application types, any case (council words such as 'Householder planning permission' are mapped onto it): householder, full, outline, reserved_matters, variation_of_condition, non_material_amendment, details_reserved_by_condition, listed_building_consent, advertisement, lawful_development_proposed, lawful_development_existing, lawful_works_listed_building, prior_approval, tree_works, high_hedge, eia_screening_or_scoping, observations_to_another_authority, ecclesiastical_exemption, other; application_type_full keeps the council's own words
application_type.title: Application Type

decision.description: decisions: the council's own words, matched exactly (e.g. 'Refused Permission', 'Permission Refused'), or an outcome — approved | refused | withdrawn | other | unknown — which matches every wording normalised to it, as aggregate_applications counts them: ['Refused'] finds every refusal however the council words it. Each result's outcome says which it is.
decision.title: Decision

development_category.description: Only these development categories: home_improvement | small_residential (1-9 net new homes) | medium_residential (10-49) | large_residential (50+) | mixed | tree. Read by a model from the description; applications not yet read never match.
development_category.title: Development Category

development_type.description: Development category (the old name for development_category; the same values). Applications not yet read by the scheme-facts model never match.
development_type.title: Development Type

has_appeal.description: true: only applications with a linked appeal (the appeals bodies' casework and the councils' published appeal letters, joined on the council's own reference); false: only those with no linked appeal.
has_appeal.title: Has Appeal

is_major.description: true: only major developments; false: only schemes read as not major. Applications not yet read never match.
is_major.title: Is Major

lpa.description: restrict to specific covered LPA slugs
lpa.title: Lpa

max_net_new_homes.description: Only schemes creating at most this many net new homes (as read from the description; 0 = none). 'A few homes' is min_net_new_homes 1 with max_net_new_homes 9. Applications not yet read never match.
max_net_new_homes.title: Max Net New Homes

min_net_new_homes.description: Only schemes creating at least this many net new homes (as read from the description).
min_net_new_homes.title: Min Net New Homes

outcome.description: only these outcomes, normalised from each council's own decision wording: approved | refused | withdrawn | other | unknown (unknown = blank or a placeholder); the same values aggregate_applications counts by.
outcome.title: Outcome

work_kind.description: Only these principal kinds of work: new_building | demolition_and_redevelopment | extension_rear_or_side | extension_roof | basement | change_of_use | subdivision_or_amalgamation | external_alterations | internal_alterations | shopfront | advertisement | plant_and_equipment | telecommunications | renewable_energy | tables_and_chairs | tree_works | roof_terrace_or_balcony | public_realm_or_highway | temporary | repairs_and_restoration | other. New homes on a plot are new_building (and demolition_and_redevelopment where something is cleared first); a conversion is subdivision_or_amalgamation or change_of_use. Read by a model from the description; applications not yet read never match.
work_kind.title: Work Kind

NearbyFilters.title: NearbyFilters

cursor.description: opaque keyset cursor from a prior page.
cursor.title: Cursor

filters.description: optional, AND-combined filters: date windows (validated/decided), application type, development category, kind of work, major, net new homes, decision or outcome, status, appeal, and LPA.

limit.description: How many results to return: 1 to 10 (default 10).
limit.title: Limit

radius_m.description: search radius in metres; default 1609 (=1 mile), max 5000.
radius_m.title: Radius M

sort.description: result ordering: 'distance' (nearest first, the default), 'valid_date_desc' (most recent applications first, by validation date) or 'decision_date_desc' (most recent decisions first).
sort.title: Sort

title: Find applications near a place
